[427]: Diversity-bandwidth tradeoff

[428]: g3e00392bbbc_0_503

[429]: Original Granovetter argument conceives of the properties of ties (e.g., strength) in static terms
Yet information transmission/access are events that happen in time
In original Strength of Weak Ties argument:
Weak ties: Novel information
Strong ties: Old/redundant information

[677]: The strength of high bandwidth ties:
More trust, intimacy, and cooperativeness
Better memory of who knows what
More effective at transferring complex, interdependent information
Creating new knowledge (e.g., bringing together rather than keeping apart)
Commonality of interests and experience (homophily)
